source_rig: Viggle Motion 3D metahuman_body (86 joints), GLB export

axis_offset.note: Xandra world bone frame = Viggle world bone frame @ offset. Measured 88.3 deg about +Y on rest-matched bones (spine, legs, feet; residual = real rest-pose differences); the convention is the exact quarter turn.

not_mapped.fingers: channels=body; finger channels are left at rest
not_mapped.twist: Viggle has no arm twist bones; xms.solve.twist distributes arm roll

binding: registered skeleton (profile files rig.npz); any clothing asset with this rig
